claim_boundary.sampled_evidence: A passing shadow trace is empirical evidence about the pinned run only. It cannot prove global passivity, global fidelity, global PL, or stability of a neural-network loss.
claim_boundary.synthetic_exclusion: P21 synthetic records are infrastructure tests and may not be substituted for this P22 real-gradient acquisition.
claim_boundary.update_isolation: The P20 output is observed only. Fresh-process trace-off-A, trace-off-B, and trace-on runs must apply the same unshielded pinned baseline update. Off-A and off-B must first pass the bitwise repeatability gate; only then may off-A and trace-on be used for the execution-specific noninterference validation.

trainer.integration: The isolated P22 trainer imports model.py from this clean checkout, replaces stock AdamW with the pinned SingleDeviceMuonWithAuxAdam, separates architectural block size 1024 from training sequence length 128, and disables evaluation/checkpointing. Its exact source bytes and SHA-256 are mandatory run provenance.
trainer.instrumentation: A separate isolated wrapper observes the exact module-global muon_update called by the pinned optimizer. It may clone values for a record-only hook but may not change the returned candidate. Its exact bytes and SHA-256 are mandatory run provenance.

run.accelerator_backend: explicitly selected cuda or mps; never cpu or automatic fallback
run.autocast: disabled; model forward/backward, parameters, gradients, EMA and Nesterov remain FP32; only the pinned five Newton-Schulz stages use BF16
run.mps_environment: PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=0 is required and PYTORCH_MPS_FAST_MATH must be unset or 0.
run.mps_scope: An Apple-MPS run is valid BF16-stored backend-specific shadow evidence, but it is not CUDA, GPU-kernel parity, native BF16-accumulation, or tensor-core certification.

model.muon_parameter_rule: Every hidden two-dimensional transformer-block weight; token/position embeddings, tied language-model head, layer-normalization gains, and all vectors/scalars use the auxiliary optimizer.
model.shape_extension: Each of 12 fused c_attn weights has stored PyTorch shape 2304x768 and is transposed to the separately certified P22 orientation 768x2304. The P22 exact extension and independent reconstruction must pass; the frozen P20 table is not rewritten.

optimizer.candidate_update_scope: The baseline applies the literal unshielded pinned Muon candidate. P20 is shadow-only.

data.row_order: Arrow row order at the pinned dataset revision; no shuffle before tokenization.
data.source_rule: Use complete text cells from the pinned revision in increasing row order. A datasets-server row is permitted only when its truncated_cells list is empty; otherwise fetch the revision-pinned source shard. Record every server response or source shard hash.
data.tokenization: tiktoken GPT-2 byte-pair encoding (vocab 50257, eot 50256), with one eot token appended after every document
data.stream_selection: Concatenate complete documents in pinned increasing row order. The first 131072 tokens form train.bin and the next 32768 tokens form val.bin; boundary rows and in-row token offsets are recorded.
data.training_window_schedule: At optimizer step t, use train.bin[t*128:t*128+128] as input and the one-token shift as target. Record every one of the 256 starting offsets and batch hashes; no random sampler or shuffle is used.
data.hash_requirements: The full dataset revision, every datasets-server response or consumed source shard, preprocessing source, tiktoken assets, train.bin, and val.bin must be SHA-256 pinned and locally verified before accelerator work.

capture.parameter_selection: All 48 intended Muon hidden matrices at every one of the 24 capture steps; no post-hoc parameter, layer, role, norm, or success selection.
capture.timing: After accumulation and before parameter update, inside the actual pinned accelerator muon_update path.
capture.stored_signal: The actual stored Nesterov signal consumed by the accelerator orthogonalizer.
capture.pre_aspect_candidate: Optional diagnostic when the pinned call boundary exposes the actual accelerator value after five BF16 Jordan stages and orientation restoration but before aspect scaling. Record null plus a reason when unavailable; never reconstruct it on CPU.
capture.post_aspect_candidate: The actual stored accelerator candidate after the pinned aspect multiply; this is the fidelity comparator and the candidate supplied to the CPU proof-reference P20 shadow.
capture.shadow_output: P20 output computed from detached contiguous CPU copies and never returned to, or read by, the baseline optimizer.
capture.record_only: Hashes and predeclared metrics are retained for every matrix. Raw matrices are not required to be published, but any retained raw bundle must be hashed and access-controlled before inspection.

noninterference.initial_state: All three fresh processes start from byte-identical model, optimizer, deterministic sequential data schedule, and RNG state.
noninterference.observer_rng_rule: At each capture, Python, NumPy, Torch CPU, and the explicitly selected CUDA or MPS RNG state must be bitwise unchanged across the observer call; a violation restores the pre-call RNG and aborts.
per_step_equality: Python/NumPy/Torch CPU and selected-accelerator RNG-state bytes
noninterference.state_equality_schedule: Hash every model parameter/buffer and the complete optimizer state initially, after each of the 24 capture-schedule steps, and finally. This avoids roughly a terabyte of redundant accelerator-to-host hashing while still placing exact state checkpoints around every observer-bearing update.
noninterference.final_equality: Off-A must first match off-B, then off-A must match trace-on, for every scheduled digest and final model/optimizer/RNG digest. Tolerances and approximate floating-point comparisons are forbidden.

required_before_run: clean exact nanoGPT checkout and hashed instrumentation patch
materialized and locally SHA-256-verified FineWeb/tokenizer manifest
one explicitly selected BF16-capable CUDA or MPS device under the frozen deterministic settings
100% P20/P22 coverage of the 48-name GPT-2-small Muon inventory
passing trace-off-A/trace-off-B repeatability comparison followed by trace-off-A/trace-on noninterference comparison
fail_closed.reason: No materialized FineWeb bundle or complete three-run accelerator acquisition and comparison result is committed.
